definition: Share of labeled sampled reviews with at least one valid positive communication label; distinct listing-plus-review keys.
peer_scope: Other listings with the exact Google category Hospital.

comparisons.group: Other Hospital-category listings, all labeled reviews
Hospital A, 4–5 stars and at least 25 words
Other Hospital-category listings, 4–5 stars and at least 25 words

manual_reading.behavior: Explains steps, procedures, results, or the care plan
Answers questions or listens to concerns/preferences
Mentions comfort, ease, relief, being heard, or not feeling rushed
Explicitly includes family in updates or answers

qualifications: Google listings can aggregate outpatient, inpatient, and specialty services. Category and coarse service-topic controls do not match acuity or actual service mix.
Case selection used the same data; intervals do not account for selection, clustering, label error, or review self-selection.
Positive communication and feelings of reassurance are co-reported. No intervention date, actual waiting records, anxiety scale, or causal effect is observed.
The manual reading covers all 26 model-selected communication-positive case reviews, not an independent audit of the full labeling dataset.
Sample inclusion weights address the sampling design, not propensity to write a review.
The hospital identity and identifying review details are omitted from the proposed public narrative. Verbatim review quotes can be searched; use de-identified paraphrases.
selection: Exploratory shortlist of Hospital/General hospital/University hospital categories with >=100 recent labeled reviews; selected communication-rich case after inspection, not a held-out test or validated best hospital.
